Release build copies vendored nemo-speech.exe and supporting DLLs and licenses to target/release, and NSIS packages them into application root
Unit tests verify tamper rejection on equal-length model files, RTTM timestamp parsing, overlap handling, and malformed line rejection

unverified_release_claims.claim: Nemotron V3 is a Speech-to-Text (ASR) transcription engine in Suflyor
unverified_release_claims.evidence: Nemotron V3 is integrated exclusively as a speaker diarization engine (DiarEngine::Nemotron3 in overlay-backend/src/diarize.rs:72 and overlay-backend/src/nemotron_diar.rs:24-88). It does not transcribe speech, outputs only RTTM speaker segment intervals, and is not a variant of SttBackendCfg.

gaps.description: No automated CI tests exist for native execution of nemo-speech.exe or runtime diarization. Only static unit tests of RTTM parsing and model file digest checks are run in Cargo.
install_nemotron downloads a ~102 MB GGUF asset from HuggingFace on demand. If network connectivity fails or HuggingFace is unreachable, no fallback offline model is available.

While OpenMDW-1.1 license files are packaged into the installer under $INSTDIR\licenses\nemotron, the Slint transcript UI initiates model download without presenting the OpenMDW-1.1 license terms to the user.
